who_pays: BioLife Plasma Services pays you on a BioLife Debit Card — a Debit Mastercard that works anywhere debit is accepted — issued when you donate.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, weigh at least 110 lbs, and bring a valid photo ID, proof of SSN, and proof of address — then pass the medical screening and physical exam. The $700 coupon is for first-time donors only and must be presented BEFORE your first donation. You are screened every visit; failing screening means no donation and no pay.
work_available: STILL LIVE as of today (2026-09-23): the official $700 new-donor coupon (offer code 40019) is active on BioLife's site, but your FIRST donation must be completed by 09/27/2026 — days away — with the remaining 7 within 30 days after. Miss the deadline and this coupon is gone; check your BioLife app's Promotions tab for whatever coupon replaces it.
what_gets_accepted: Only successful, completed donations count toward the coupon schedule ($100/$115/$80/$80/$80/$85/$85/$75) — a deferred visit at screening earns nothing and still burns calendar time inside your 30-day window.
costs_and_unpaid_time: The first visit is 2-3 hours of screening and physical before you see the needle; return visits run about 90-180 minutes. That's a needle in your arm, 8 trips in 30 days, travel, and waiting — all unpaid. Without the coupon presented up front there is no bonus at all.
when_cash_arrives: Paid per successful donation onto your BioLife Debit Card — same visit or within 24 hours.
